identity.defect: Video rows can never be inserted: dimensions_check requires pixel_count = width*height whenever dimensions exist, while kind_facts_check requires video pixel_count IS NULL — the two CHECKs contradict, so every MP4 upload fails at INSERT with 500 after blob cleanup.

findings.dispositionReason: Verified contradiction: video sets width/height NOT NULL and pixel_count NULL per kind_facts; dimensions_check then fails. No real-MP4 integration test exists, which is why it slipped. Repair: drop the redundant dimensions_check (kind_facts_check already enforces per-kind fact consistency including image pixel math) and add a real MP4 upload test.

identity.source: #156 AC6 / plan per-kind ceilings (image 10MiB, audio 50MiB, video 200MiB)
identity.defect: The size ceiling is chosen from the sniffed container family before probing; an MP4-family audio (M4A) is streamed under the 200MiB video ceiling and accepted as audio up to 200MiB, violating the 50MiB audio limit.

findings.dispositionReason: Sniff cannot distinguish audio-only MP4 from video MP4; the authoritative kind arrives only after Identify. Repair: re-check put.ByteSize against identified.Kind().SizeLimit() after probing and reject with ErrTooLarge (plus cleanup).
evidence: material_service.go Put uses family.Kind().SizeLimit() from sniff
domain value.go: AudioMaxBytes 50MiB, VideoMaxBytes 200MiB
no post-probe size recheck
targeted re-review R1: material_service.go:109 re-checks put.ByteSize against identified.Kind().SizeLimit() with cleanup; TestUploadRejectsOversizedMP4AudioUnderVideoCeiling asserts 413.

identity.source: #156 AC6 (server-side authoritative validation of duration and readability)
identity.defect: A file with one plausible Layer III frame header followed by arbitrary garbage is accepted, and its duration is estimated from total bytes by CBR math — readability and duration are not authoritative.

findings.dispositionReason: AC6 demands authoritative validation; frame continuity is the defining property of a real MP3. Repair: after the first header, validate consecutive frames by stepping frame length (144*bitrate/rate + padding) and require a minimum run of consecutive valid headers (or a Xing/Info frame count); otherwise reject as unreadable.
evidence: mp3.go: single parseMP3Header acceptance, findSyncWindow accepts first plausible header
duration falls back to total-bytes CBR estimate regardless of body
targeted re-review R1: mp3.go requires Xing/Info count + >=1 chained frame or >=3 consecutive CBR frames via frameStrideBytes; garbage-after-one-header case added and PASS.

identity.defect: Malformed and multi-range requests return full 200 content, while the contract documents 416 RangeNotSatisfiable for 多区间、语法错误、start 越过 EOF.

findings.dispositionReason: The public contract promises 416 for present-but-invalid ranges; the implementation is RFC-permissive instead. Align the handler to the contract (present && !valid → 416) and update range tests.
evidence: contracts/creation.yaml:266-267,455: 不支持多区间与非法区间（416）
range.go: invalid → valid=false → resolveRange serves full content
targeted re-review R1: DownloadMaterial: present && (!valid || !satisfiable) -> 416; four invalid shapes asserted in the download test; contract already documented this.

identity.defect: The contract states the server checksum-verifies during delivery for every response, but only full-body responses are verified in-stream; partial (206) responses carry the digest header without server-side verification.

findings.dispositionReason: A whole-blob SHA-256 cannot verify a subrange without reading the unsent bytes, and pre-verifying before delivery would require buffering or double reads that break the bounded-streaming contract; severing the connection on mid-stream mismatch is the honest design for full transfers. The defect is contract precision: scope the on-the-fly verification wording to full responses and document the digest header as the partial-response verification channel.
evidence: contracts/creation.yaml:267: 服务端在下发过程中即时校验 (unscoped)
materials_transfer.go digestMismatch comment: partial serves skip the verdict
targeted re-review R1: contracts/creation.yaml:266-270 wording now scopes in-stream checksum verification to full responses; 206 documented as carrying X-Content-SHA-256 for client verification.

identity.defect: Open runs StatObject under context.WithoutCancel, so a canceled download leaves the HEAD request running instead of aborting promptly.

findings.dispositionReason: Cancellation must propagate to every in-flight provider call; the caller context is the correct one. Pass ctx to StatObject.
evidence: s3.go Open: s.client.StatObject(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), …)
targeted re-review R1: s3.go:95 StatObject(ctx, ...) uses the caller context.
